history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man with dark, tousled hair stands on a city sidewalk, looking to his right. He is wearing a light blue, short-sleeved button-up shirt, partially unbuttoned, over a white t-shirt with a red graphic. His pants are very wide-legged and black, with a silver chain attached to one of the belt loops. He is also wearing dark, flat shoes.

Behind him, a street scene unfolds. A sign on a lamppost reads "MENYEBERANG TEKAN TOMBOL" which translates to "CROSS PRESS BUTTON". The building in the background has a white facade with arched windows and the words "COMMISSIONAIRS VENDUHOLDERS" inscribed on it. The architecture suggests a historical European influence.

The street is paved with gray tiles and marked with a crosswalk. Several motorcycles and a truck are visible in the background, indicating a bustling urban environment. The lighting is natural daylight, casting soft shadows. The color palette is dominated by muted blues, grays, and whites, with the yellow and black striped pole in the foreground adding a bold contrast. The overall mood is casual and urban, with a hint of retro style.
